title: BPW-2026-0496
text:
[JOINT REPORT(S)]
BPW-2026-0496
BOE + BOS
CD 13
CONSTRUCTION BUDGET AND AWARD – EMERGENCY SEWER REPAIR (ESR) ON-CALL CONTRACT FLETCHER DRIVE (2600 BLOCK) PROJECT
Recommending the Board:
AUTHORIZE a construction budget of $1,759,998.90, including contingency, for the ESR Fletcher Drive Project;
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to award this Project to the lowest, responsive, and responsible bidder, Mike Bubalo Construction Company, Inc. in compliance with established procedures of the On-Call Emergency Sewer and Storm Drain Repairs Contract; and
AUTHORIZE the City Engineer to issue construction orders, revised construction orders, and change orders up to the authorized construction budget for this Project to Mike Bubalo Construction Company, Inc.
(W.O.: SZC14471, C-141939)
summary: Award of construction contract for emergency sewer repair on Fletcher Drive in Council District 13 for $1,759,998.90.
